submittedArguments.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Output exactly one 1254 x 1254 opaque square CLOSE-UP game-art crop. Image 1 is the edit target and exact camera crop. Preserve the framing, scale and every sharp edge-overlap. Redraw all blurred central pixels as genuinely crisp hand-painted native detail. Continue shapes seamlessly across sharp/blur transition without reproducing a rectangular guide boundary. Never zoom out or change object size. This target shows only about 27 x 27 pixels of the full map. All content must remain tightly cropped.
LOCAL CONTENT: Very tightly cropped tall IVORY POST BODY across the RIGHT half. The single round ball cap lies ABOVE this crop; top sharp strip anchors its body. The SAME tall shaft must continue ALL THE WAY DOWN beyond this crop to match the large post body in the BOTTOM sharp strip. NO base/plinth/ground under the right post within this crop. Do not fit or shorten the whole post inside square. Connect the low ivory wall entering from left to the tall post, and the wall on its right to the right sharp strip. Preserve exact post widths at top and bottom, use tall uninterrupted surfaces.
All sharp top/bottom/left/right strips in image 1 are positioned native adjacent art and are the geometric authority; preserve the exact object contours, stone-joint endpoints, spacing, thickness and shade at those strips. Continue them into the blurry area with identical perspective and materials. No extra scene, building, object or foreground framing. No composite panels. Full square output.
Images 2,3,4 are ONLY full-map layout, material, approved Q Daoist painting-style references; they must NEVER cause any of their surrounding scene or buildings to be added into this tiny crop. Daylight, clean natural pale grey/blue-grey stone, soft hand-painted shading, rounded graceful forms, restrained gold. No photoreal grain, blur, excessive scratches, plastic, text, UI, people, animals, watermark. Exact patch r10_c10_p24, core local [115,115,1139,1139).
